leading_indicator._description: Two-layer indicator model (journeys/). qual_score is the recency-weighted behavioral composite over signal_window_days; divergence = qual_score - kpi_only_score; |divergence| >= divergence_warning_pts labels the month early_warning (leading below trailing) or recovery_watch (leading above). decay_lambda_per_day 0.023 = ~30-day half-life, the monthly-upload default from the Recency-Signal-DNA spec. unreviewed_low_confidence_weight scales a signal the extractor flagged requires_review until a human accepts / reclassifies it (rejected evidence is excluded entirely).

phase_rules._description: Journey phase per scored month from health band + slope (pts/month). resolution: slope > resolution_slope_pts and health >= at_risk.min after a prior dip below at_risk.min; intervention: health < at_risk.min; deterioration: slope < deterioration_slope_pts and health < healthy.min + deterioration_health_ceiling_offset; else baseline.

data_coverage._description: Derived per account at every journey rebuild — never configured per tenant. kpi_layer: present (scored month within kpi_stale_after_days) | stale (scored, but older) | not_yet (no KPI yet, evidence younger than no_kpi_layer_after_days, subscription contract) | none (no KPI layer: evidence older than that, or an installed-base contract). Phases, arc predicates, backtest comparator and wording branch on it and SAY which way they went.

evidence_phase_rules._description: Journey phases from evidence alone (no KPI layer). Per month: an intervention-role signal → intervention; more negative-role than positive-role signals → deterioration; a positive month after a negative/intervention phase → resolution; a quiet month keeps the previous phase until quiet_months_to_baseline in a row, then baseline.
